propositions: MCP unlink_tickets adapter omits the optional relation parameter from both its FastMCP registered signature and its rebar.unlink delegate call, preventing relation-scoped edge removal
The live MCP schema does not advertise relation as an optional field despite it being supported in the public library and CLI contracts
When a ticket pair holds multiple relations (e.g., blocks and relates_to), MCP unlink removes the newest edge instead of the explicitly requested relation
The signed write-surface parity ruling requires zero intended divergences between library, CLI, and MCP implementations of unlink

Adding relation: str | None = None to the MCP callable signature and forwarding it unchanged to rebar.unlink restores parity and enables relation-scoped removal while preserving pair-scoped fallback behavior
